statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The latest verified NQ path evidence available before the cutoff did not show a fresh one-way extension, while current supplementary cross-sectional evidence remained conflicted.
recommendation: Published policy mapping: EA_ON. Tail remains below the WATCH threshold; the next concentrated risk window is the U.S. cash-open and Employer Costs sequence on September 9.
headline: Tail remains low overnight while oil, rates and geopolitics keep Stress extreme
body: The latest verified delayed NQ reference available before the cutoff was 29,525.75 at 22:59:59 UTC, about 101 points above Tuesday's 29,424.75 session low. Fresh Finviz context at 23:00:50 UTC showed six of eight tracked megacaps lower but five of seven semiconductors higher, supporting a conflicted rather than uniformly directional technology backdrop.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hours, published Tail ranged from 16% to 32%. The peak occurred during Tuesday's 14:00 UTC cash-open downside extension; later repair returned Tail below the blocking band while Stress remained high to extreme.
outlookSummary: The overnight baseline remains low Tail if two-sided rotation persists. Conditional WATCH risk concentrates around September 9 from 13:20-15:30 UTC, covering the U.S. cash-open transition and Employer Costs release, with a separate Apple-event checkpoint at 17:00 UTC.

forecast.analysis: The latest verified NQ structure available before the cutoff was the 22:59:59 UTC delayed reference near 29,525.75. With no verified fresh one-way extension and fresh cross-sectional evidence still conflicted, Tail remains low while macro Stress stays extreme.

forecast.analysis: If early overnight trading remains two-sided, Tail stays low. The main escalation condition is a break that holds near an overnight extreme while counter-moves become shallow.
The Asia handoff keeps a low-Tail baseline if directional efficiency remains limited. Geopolitical headlines remain primarily a Stress amplifier unless live NQ structure confirms persistence.
Mid-Asia remains low Tail if pullbacks continue to interrupt direction. Repeated extension after weak counter-moves would be the adverse path to reassess.
Late Asia keeps a low-Tail baseline if price rotates through prior levels instead of holding an overnight extreme. A clean directional carry into Europe would challenge that baseline.
The Asia-to-Europe transition remains low Tail if price discovery stays two-sided. A persistent overnight move handed directly into European liquidity would raise concern.
Early Europe remains low Tail unless the overnight move accelerates with shallow repairs. Conflicted technology leadership argues against assuming uniform Nasdaq direction.

forecast.analysis: European morning risk stays contained if NQ continues to retrace intraday swings. A sustained directional move with aligned rates and oil would increase Tail.
As Europe matures, Tail remains low provided cross-asset pressure is not reinforced by one-way NQ structure. Failed counter-moves would be the key negative change.
Late European trade remains a low-Tail window if price stays rotational. Persistent movement toward a session extreme ahead of U.S. liquidity would raise the risk profile.
Ahead of the U.S. pre-open, Tail edges toward the top of the low band because liquidity and catalyst sensitivity increase. The baseline still assumes meaningful repair remains available.
Pre-open event sensitivity increases, but no blocking path is assumed. Tail would rise only if premarket direction becomes persistent and counter-moves fail as U.S. liquidity builds.
The hour before the main cash-open window moves into WATCH territory conditionally. Risk centers on whether overnight direction survives the liquidity transition with shallow repair.

forecast.analysis: Cash-open transition risk is near the top of WATCH. A persistent opening-auction move with shallow pullbacks would be the key path toward the blocking threshold; normal two-sided discovery would argue against escalation.

forecast.analysis: Employer Costs at 14:00 UTC creates a high-Stress checkpoint during active U.S. price discovery. Tail remains WATCH unless the release is followed by persistent directional extension and failed repair.
The first post-release hour remains WATCH for a delayed second leg. Tail should stay below blocking territory if the initial move retraces meaningfully and cross-assets stop reinforcing direction.
If the post-event path has stabilized by this hour, Tail falls toward the lower WATCH boundary. Continued repeated extension would invalidate that normalization assumption.

Apple's 17:00 UTC event is a company-level volatility checkpoint for a major Nasdaq weight. Tail remains WATCH unless index-level price action becomes persistently directional rather than simply volatile.
After the Apple checkpoint, Tail stays near WATCH only if event-driven movement continues without meaningful retracement. Orderly digestion would favor a return to low Tail.
Late U.S. afternoon risk returns to low Tail if event effects fade and NQ rotates away from extremes. Persistent trend efficiency into the close would be the main adverse condition.
Into the cash close, Tail remains low unless the closing sequence extends a one-way move without repair. Closing-auction volatility alone is treated primarily as Stress.
Post-close risk is low if the session ends with repaired structure. New geopolitical or corporate headlines could raise Stress, but Tail still requires directional price-path confirmation.
The futures maintenance and liquidity transition keep the baseline low Tail. Thin conditions can increase noise, but sustained no-retracement structure would still be required for higher Tail.
Early reopened futures trade remains low Tail if price discovery is two-sided. A fresh directional break that holds near the new session extreme would be the main overnight escalation trigger.

forecastDetail.comment: Current evidence is insufficient to establish persistent one-way NQ structure; Tail remains low while external Stress is extreme.
Low Tail is conditional on two-sided overnight trade and meaningful counter-moves.
Asia handoff remains low Tail unless directional efficiency rises materially.
Mid-Asia stays low Tail if retracements continue to interrupt direction.
Late Asia remains low Tail unless price carries an extreme cleanly toward Europe.
Asia-to-Europe handoff stays low Tail if price discovery remains two-sided.
